name: GoatCounter
description: Privacy-friendly web analytics: one script tag on your site, and GoatCounter counts page views, referrers, browsers and countries without cookies or personal data. One small container with its SQLite database on the data volume.

access.note: A fresh GoatCounter has no site and no account: the first visitor to the address is shown the wizard that creates both, so open it yourself as soon as the deployment is ready. Give the site this deployment's domain as its address — GoatCounter picks the site to show from the name it was reached by — and the wizard then prints the script tag to paste into the pages you want counted.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address the dashboard and the count script are reached at. GoatCounter reads it from each request, so nothing else here changes when it is set.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The dashboard and the count endpoint the script tag reports to

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database of sites, users and every counted hit

update.notes: The image starts with -automigrate, so GoatCounter runs pending database migrations on start; downgrading needs the backup.
